meta.title: ASN–PO Auto-Linking: refused for a user without the Warehouse Executive role
gaps: Open and attempt the ASN–PO Auto-Linking action to auto-link an ASN to its source PO.
Sign in as a user without the Warehouse Executive role and verify the action is refused or absent.
Repeat the action as a Warehouse Executive and verify it is available.
Verify the tenant is on the Enterprise plan and record any RBAC configuration that grants access to additional roles.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Open and attempt the ASN–PO Auto-Linking action to auto-link an ASN to its source PO.; Sign in as a user without the Warehouse Executive role and verify the action is refused or absent.; Repeat the action as a Warehouse Executive and verify it is available.; Verify the tenant is on the Enterprise plan and record any RBAC configuration that grants access to additional roles.

args.need: sign in as the user without the Warehouse Executive role and as a Warehouse Executive on the specified Enterprise tenant, attempt ASN–PO Auto-Linking as each user, and record whether the action is refused, absent, or available

steps.note: The required ASN workflow and role-specific sessions are not represented in the catalog.
